sections.title: Controls and how each is verified
sections.lead: Prototype security engineering, honestly separated from what a production fintech adds (see caveats).

rows: Authentication, roles, ownership, bad/expired/forged tokens, rate limits, CORS, input abuse

one bit flipped in ai1/model.txt → 503 with the file named; restored → 200
requests during the outage fail fast; audit chain verifies after each crash

key ring with key ids; retired keys rejected
scripts/rotate_jwt_key.py; secrets from env or a file outside the repo
phones, IDs, emails, cards, links removed

sections.takeaway: Nothing here is a claim without a test or a scan behind it.

caveats: Production fintech additionally needs a KMS/HSM for keys, WORM storage for the audit log, a SIEM, and an external penetration test.
Signing keys are random per start unless a key ring is configured; then tokens survive restarts.
